title: lycopodium pumilum var. bryoides
intro: Lycopodium pumilum var. bryoides, commonly known as the Dwarf Club Moss or Moss Lycopodium, is a type of small, evergreen shrub-like plant that belongs to the club moss family (Lycopodiaceae). The health benefits of Lycopodium pumilum var. bryoides include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antiseptic agent, which can help to treat skin conditions and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Lycopodium pumilum var. bryoides include alkaloids such as lycoctonine, anhydrolycoctonine, and lycoctonine oxide, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
